references.text: Joshua carries out Moses' command to build an altar on Mount Ebal and read aloud the blessings and curses, as Moses commanded in Deuteronomy 27.
Moses had previously instructed that the blessing should be proclaimed from Mount Gerizim and the curse from Mount Ebal, in preparation for the command given in chapter 27.
Moses continues by elaborating on the blessings that will come upon the people if they keep the Lord's commands, following up on the instruction given on this day.
Moses instructs the Levites and the elders on how the law should be read aloud to the people, continuing his command to the people.
